benchmark: ConceptGraphs GT object embedding and text-query retrieval

measurement.primary: macro-average AP for category-text queries retrieving matching ground-truth objects from the complete object bank
measurement.secondary: macro-average zero-shot category top-1 accuracy, top-5 accuracy, query recall@K, and encoder throughput
measurement.query_scope: each query is a shared category name such as 'a photo of a chair'; this measures category retrieval, not arbitrary referring expressions

inputs.ground-truth-box: padded human-annotated COCO boxes; production-faithful crop, since current ConceptGraphs CLIP embeddings use padded boxes and do not apply mask pixels
inputs.ground-truth-masked-object: same proposals and labels, but pixels outside each human-annotated instance polygon use the model-specific processor mean RGB; these pixels normalize to approximately zero and isolate object appearance from context
inputs.ground-truth-native-roi: FG-CLIP2-only supplemental input: the full source image and oracle GT box are passed through FG-CLIP2's native RoIAlign feature API; box text embeddings use walk_type=box. This is a model-specific fine-grained path and is not the apples-to-apples crop replacement path used by the main two conditions.

measurement.scope: fixed oracle proposals, masks, and labels isolate the image/text embedding component; category-name queries proxy free-form user descriptions; this does not measure proposal quality, temporal object aggregation, or full 3D mapping replay
measurement.domain_limit: COCO categories and images differ from the project's Replica and user-recorded scenes
measurement.caption_to_label: Each human COCO image caption is used as a text query. Keyword-matched COCO category labels present in that same image define relevant GT object crops. Regions are ranked over the full object bank using each model's image/text embeddings. This is weakly grounded because captions describe complete images rather than individual instances.
measurement.dino: not included in text-query scores because DINOv3 has no joint image/text embedding space; test it separately on ground-truth tracked-object association if that visual-only use is under consideration

dataset.proposal_source: human-annotated COCO instance masks and bounding boxes

captions.matching: case-insensitive word-boundary keyword matching against COCO category names plus listed common aliases; only labels present in the same image are considered positives
captions.grounding_limit: COCO captions describe whole images, not individually annotated instances. Positive regions are assigned by image ID and mentioned category, so this is a weakly grounded caption-to-label retrieval measure.
